theses.thesis: MU has the cleanest contrarian alignment: purchases disclosed by three members are net positive, insider buying pressure is strong, and the large patent cluster points to continuing technical investment while the shares have lagged SPY [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]. Uniformly bullish Stocktwits sentiment supports attention but is the least durable component [stocktwits_bull]. Earnings in 12 days create material event risk, so the read is medium rather than high conviction.
theses.thesis_zh: MU呈现最清晰的逆向共振：三名议员披露的交易合计为净买入，内部人士买入压力较强，大规模专利集群显示技术投入仍在持续，而股价相对SPY落后 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]。Stocktwits一致看多说明关注度较高，但这是其中持续性最弱的信号 [stocktwits_bull]。距离财报仅12天，事件风险显著，因此置信度为中等而非高。
